description: Runtime invocation routing edge cases: an empty call list produces no output, and call ordering/identifier forwarding is preserved for mixed async-then-sync sequences and for a single sync_with_result form.

cases.expected_output:
call=async_without_result
runtime_identifier=a.b.c.d
runtime_call=async
error=runtime_call_not_implemented
call=sync_without_result
runtime_identifier=a.b.c.d
runtime_call=sync
error=runtime_call_not_implemented
